summary: MINISO Group Holding Limited filed a Form 6-K with a Hong Kong Next Day Disclosure Return (Exhibit 99.1) detailing share cancellations. On August 24, 2026, the company cancelled 19,038,400 shares repurchased on the Hong Kong Exchange from August 21, 2025 to June 11, 2026 at HKD 29.0173 per share, and 5,880,544 shares repurchased on the NYSE from November 20, 2025 to June 10, 2026 at USD 3.9297 per share. These cancellations reduced total issued shares to 1,214,041,449, representing a combined 2.01% reduction. The board confirmed compliance with listing rules. What to watch: continued share buyback activity and potential future cancellations.
